web-guide-idea-61.audience: Learners who want regular speaking time with peers.
web-guide-idea-61.offer: Run a small conversation group where everyone gets a turn. Sell facilitated practice and useful feedback, not a crowded call where only confident speakers talk.
web-guide-idea-61.steps.0: Set a topic and explain turn-taking.
web-guide-idea-61.steps.1: Use short role-plays in pairs or a round-robin.
web-guide-idea-61.steps.2: Recap common improvements and invite each person to try again.
web-guide-idea-61.equipment: A phone, earphones and a quiet room. Prepare prompts and a timer.
web-guide-idea-61.returnReason: Change the topic weekly and let learners recognise progress in speaking confidence.
web-guide-idea-61.promotion: Share an example speaking game and state the group size and level.
